Description: Absolute digital barometric pressure sensor, dual FS (1260/4060 hPa), I2C / MIPI I3C, Qvar
Notes: Fixed I2C address 0x5C (no SA0 pin) - reason the mux is needed. U8 is in the schematic but NOT placed on the PCB. AH1/AH2->GND OK when Qvar unused (AN5778); also write reg 0x5F=0x00 in FW. PAD2LID->GND OK.
A0/A1/A2 = GND -> address 0x70 (same as MCU-board mux; OK behind the upstream mux). RESET (pin 3) floating - add 10k to 3V3.

Description: MLCC, VDD decoupling (one per sensor + one at mux)
Notes: C14 is missing from production/bom.csv (stale). Place one 100 nF at each ILPS28QSW VDD and at U7 VCC.

Description: MLCC, bulk decoupling (one per sensor + one at mux)
Notes: C13 is missing from production/bom.csv (stale). 4.7 uF in 0402 derates heavily with DC bias - effective C may be ~1-2 uF; acceptable for decoupling. Consider 0603 if space allows.
